What an incredible dining experience at Culinara Dubai!

Located on Level 24 of The Link at One&Only One Za’abeel, Culinara brings together 11 chef-led dining concepts and flavours from around the world—all under one roof.

From ramen and freshly baked pizza to Indian, Lebanese, Mediterranean and Persian cuisine, everyone can order exactly what they’re craving, straight from the table.

Add spectacular views of the Dubai Frame, Burj Khalifa and the city skyline, and you have one of Dubai’s most exciting social dining destinations. Perfect for families, friends and groups with different tastes.

One of our favourite Indian tapas bars in Dubai — and for so many reasons! ❤️✨

📍 Revelry Indian Tapas Bar, Dubai Hills Estate

From the quality of the food to their seriously good handcrafted cocktails, Revelry has become one of those places we keep wanting to go back to. 🍸

But the highlight for me has to be their unique Passport Menu 🌍 — taking inspiration from cuisines around the world and giving every dish a creative Indian twist. Think global flavours meeting Indian soul, served tapas-style so you can explore and share more of the menu in one evening. 🤌🏻

The vibe is stylish yet relaxed, with a spacious setting that works equally well for a romantic date night, dinner with friends, celebrations or just a chilled evening over cocktails and good food.

If you love modern Indian food with something a little different, this is definitely one to add to your Dubai dining list. ❤️
